project_desc_1: I started this to find out how far I could get building with AI assistance. The original {link} had stopped being maintained, so there was something real to rebuild rather than a toy project. It has been running at my own feeder ever since.
project_desc_2: Frigate watches the feeder and flags anything that looks like a bird. YA-WAMF classifies it, checks it against BirdNET-Go audio, and stores the result. Every photo on this page came off that camera.

outbound.title: What leaves your network
outbound.intro: The outside services this install contacts, who makes each request and what it sends. Services at addresses you enter yourself, such as Frigate, your MQTT broker or BirdNET-Go, are not listed.
outbound.inat_desc: Bird names and species details. Sends the species name.
outbound.wikipedia_desc: Species descriptions. Sends the species name.
outbound.gbif_desc: Finds the range map for a species you open. Sends the species name.
outbound.weather_desc: Weather for each detection. Sends the feeder’s coordinates.
outbound.geolocate_desc: Finds a rough location when automatic location is on and no coordinates are saved. It sees this server’s public IP address.
outbound.places_desc: Names the place at the feeder’s coordinates in Settings. Sends the coordinates.
outbound.ebird_desc: Recent sightings near the feeder. Sends your API key and the feeder’s coordinates.
outbound.birdweather_desc: Reports detections to your station. Sends the species, the time and your station token.
outbound.inat_submit_desc: Observations you choose to submit. Sends the photo, species, time and location.
outbound.llm_desc: Behaviour notes and chat. Sends the photo or frames and the species to the provider you chose, with your key.
outbound.notify_desc: Discord, Telegram, Pushover or email. Sends the species, the time and the photo to the channels you set up.
outbound.updates_desc: Asks the YA-WAMF update service for the latest release and reads one anonymous install count. Off with update checks.
outbound.downloads_desc: Fetches model files from GitHub when you download a model, and test photos from iNaturalist and Wikimedia when you run a model evaluation.
outbound.fonts_desc: The app’s typefaces. Google sees the viewer’s IP address and browser.
outbound.photos_desc: Species photos load from Wikimedia and iNaturalist, which see the viewer’s IP address and the photo requested.
outbound.osm_desc: Maps of the feeder’s location, sightings and ranges. OpenStreetMap sees the viewer’s IP address and the area shown.
outbound.gbif_tiles_desc: The range overlay in species details. GBIF sees the viewer’s IP address and the species.
outbound.guest_note: Shown for transparency. Only the owner can change these.
